releaseInfo.releaseNotes:
Hypergamous Tree Chopping Simulator 4 - 1.5.0

- TREE MUTATIONS: Golden, Frozen, Shocked, Giant, Molten, Bloodlit, Rainbow and Celestial trees, each with its own look and effects, and up to x6 drops. Collect all 8.
- ENCHANTING TABLE window: pick any axe, see its runes, and enchant it. Enchanted axes now show on the hotbar, the inventory and in your hands.
- THE CASINO: a tower on Ashfall Isle. Coming soon.
- ANIMALS REBUILT: walking legs, heads that look around, tails, ears and blinking eyes. They graze, sit, sleep, stare and run away. None of them attack.
- OLD MINE FIX: you can now walk into the deep room and the west tunnel, so relic piece 5 can be collected. The mine rails are one connected track now.
- Trunks no longer poke out of the top of pine and Christmas trees.
- Ghost Lumberjacks bought on later islands no longer vanish when you restart the game.
